subject.title: fix(browser): support GPT-5.6 Sol Pro effort

question: Should Oracle expose `pro` as a persistent CLI/config/MCP thinking-time value that fails closed for every target except GPT-5.6 Sol selected with model strategy `select`?
rationale: The implementation is internally consistent and proven, but it intentionally defines how inherited mixed-model configurations fail, so source correctness cannot establish the desired permanent product contract.

options.title: Accept strict Pro contract
options.body: Keep `pro` across CLI, config, and MCP and reject incompatible model or strategy combinations before browser acquisition.

options.title: Narrow inherited behavior
options.body: Support explicit compatible Pro requests while preventing a global inherited `pro` value from stopping unrelated model runs.

options.title: Defer to inventory redesign
options.body: Pause this public surface until the broader direction in https://github.com/steipete/oracle/pull/319 is resolved.

recommendation.title: Accept strict Pro contract
recommendation.body: Keep `pro` across CLI, config, and MCP and reject incompatible model or strategy combinations before browser acquisition.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent GPT-5.6 release, central browser-picker/config history, and release-policy ownership make this the strongest available decision owner.
